fusions.name: Thousandth Repetition
fusions.desc: A drilled strike with the butt of the staff that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Form Without Flaw
fusions.desc: Runs a complete staff form through every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It deals 28 damage and ignores their resistances.

fusions.name: Back to First Stance
fusions.desc: You step 2 tiles from where you stood, back to the staff's full length, and the cooldown clears on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Other End Follows
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again with the other end of the staff, and the second roll stands.
